hint: What the German identifier guard lets through: names that must stay German for a stated reason. Every entry carries a reason. A file entry covers a whole file (a trailing / covers a directory, * matches inside one path segment). An identifier entry needs a pattern (regex on the whole name) and optionally a file regex and a kind (code | key). Keep it small: the way to fix a German name is to rename it. Wire and stored names that are only DEFERRED (not decided to stay) are NOT listed here: they stay in the ratchet count until they are renamed.
